name: 03_normalized_pareto_tilt
description: DELIBERATE new golden. Same span scales (financial 0.01, latency 5.0) but crank financial's MRS weight to 3.0. a: 0.002/0.01*3 + 5/5*1 = 0.6+1.0 = 1.6 ; b: 0.01/0.01*3 + 0.5/5*1 = 3.0+0.1 = 3.1. The cheap option a now overtakes the fast option b — a Pareto-frontier move that is IMPOSSIBLE under the raw latency-dominated sum at any reasonable financial weight (raw, financial's ~0.01 magnitude can never beat latency's ~5). This is normalization turning the weights into honest marginal-rates-of-substitution. Captured from the live normalized resolve on both cores.
